meta.name: Hashima Project
meta.description: A group of teenagers will now step foot on this island to capture paranormal encounters on tape. On the island, the teenagers are thrilled as they explore. However, their excitement is short-lived. They realize something ominous is creeping up on them and the hair-raising truth unveils through the lens of the camera.
meta.slogan: A deadly disrespect mission on the scariest ghost island of japan.
